Review_Text: The sound quality is decent but the battery life is terrible. It claims 48 hours but barely lasts 14 hours on a single charge.
Active Noise Cancellation is very weak. In noisy traffic or metro it filters almost nothing. Sound is clear though.
Build quality feels cheap and plasticky. The hinge creaks when opening the case. Definitely not premium as advertised.
Bass is punchy and microphone works fine for calls. But battery drain is very fast with ANC turned on.
Complete waste of money. Fast charging doesn't work with the provided cable. Took 4 hours to reach 100%.
Good earbuds for indoor study and listening to acoustic music. Bluetooth connectivity drops occasionally when moving away.
Water resistance claim is dubious. Sweat during a gym session made the left earbud stop working for two days.
Decent sound and comfortable fit for small ears. Battery lasts around 15 hours which is okay but nowhere near the 48 hours promised.
